theorems.name: Submission.variation_deformation_partials_contDiffOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (Φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N) (O : Set (ℝ × Rn N)) (m n : WithTop ℕ∞), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ Φ p.1 p.2) O → m + 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ fderiv ℝ (Φ p.1) p.2) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ deriv (fun s ↦ Φ s p.2) p.1) O
